note: None of these palettes belongs to any client. The safe default is neutral on purpose and is always reported at delivery as TO CONFIRM. Never copy another client's palette here.

safe_default.name: Neutral slate
safe_default.reason: A calm, readable slate with a soft coral highlight. It suits almost any business until your own colors replace it.

suggested.name: Calm trust
suggested.reason: Blue-green feels steady and trustworthy. Health, finance and coaching brands use it to say 'you are in safe hands'.
suggested.example: Like a wellness clinic or a financial coach.

suggested.name: Warm and welcoming
suggested.reason: Earthy terracotta feels human and inviting. It tells people you are approachable and on their side.
suggested.example: Like a boutique studio, a family business or a community group.

suggested.name: Bold and modern
suggested.reason: A strong violet with a bright highlight stands out on a crowded feed and feels current.
suggested.example: Like a creative agency or an online course brand.

font_pairs.name: Classic editorial
font_pairs.reason: Elegant headlines with very readable text.

font_pairs.name: Friendly modern
font_pairs.reason: Round, welcoming letters that stay clear on a phone.

font_pairs.name: Clean confident
font_pairs.reason: Strong headlines with a warm reading font.
